question: How are the two tetrads characterized in relation to difference and non-difference?
premises: There are two tetrads arranged in sequence.
They operate in the mode of difference and non-difference.
The first tetrad is skilled in joining the divisions of consciousness.
inference: The phonemic tetrads articulate the play of difference and unity, with the first tetrad reintegrating divided consciousness.
plain_english: There are two tetrads, in sequence, moving in difference and non-difference; the first tetrad is skilled in joining together the divisions of consciousness.
